source.note: The flight leaves TRUKN2 at its base fix, so the route is spoken "then as filed". TRUKN2 publishes FL190 and the TBM9 files 11,000, below it, so SOP 2-2 c (1) gives climb via SID except maintain 11,000, the filed altitude, and the class-T SFOW-PT-5000 interim does not apply (user decision 2026-09-15). Expect clause dropped: the chart publishes expect filed altitude 10 minutes after departure (user rule 2026-09-15).
